days.title: Юнит 1: повторение, first–tenth и месяцы
days.source: Roadmap A1 Student's Book, Unit 1 "Check and reflect" (review of lessons 1A-1D). Review day: recycle the grammar, vocabulary and speaking goals of the whole unit in free conversation. EXTRA FOCUS for this day: ordinal numbers first to tenth (and twelfth, twentieth, twenty-first, thirty-first), months of the year and saying dates (on the first of May). Use them in phrases, dialogue and drill.

notes.grammar: Порядковые числительные: first [фёст], second [сэкэнд], third [θёд], fourth [фо:θ], fifth [фифθ], sixth [сиксθ], seventh [сэвэнθ], eighth [эйтθ], ninth [найнθ], tenth [тенθ]. Дальше просто +th: eleventh, twelfth, twentieth; но twenty-first, twenty-second, twenty-third. Пишутся 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th. Даты говорим так: on the first of May / May the first. Месяцы всегда с большой буквы: January, February [фэбруэри], March, April [эйпрл], May, June, July [джулай], August [о:гэст], September, October [октоубэ], November, December [дисембэ].
